{{See also|Deathripper Dagger}} {{Infobox/Weapon |image = |rarity = l |slayer_level_requirement = Blaze Slayer 6 |damage = +160 |strength = +75 |crit_chance = +10% |crit_damage = +25% |attack_speed = +20% |upgrades_from = Kindlebane Dagger |enchant = y |reforge = y |auctionable = y |museum = y |museum_xp = 20 |museum_category = combat |raw_materials = *60000 Magmafish *9344 Derelict Ashe *46720 Red Sand *46720 Mycelium *373760 Magma Cream *373760 Glowstone Dust *373760 Nether Wart *373760 Blaze Rod *16 Inferno Vertex *1 Stick |bazaar_not_including =[[Stick]] |mat_cost_bazaar = *750 Silver Magmafish *73 MOLTEN_POWDER *16 INFERNO_VERTEX |id = HEARTFIRE_DAGGER }} The '''Pyrochaos Dagger''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Sword]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer VI}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 6}} |A1 = |B1 = Gold Magmafish, 8 |C1 = |A2 = |B2 = Molten Powder, 64 |C2 = |A3 = Inferno Vertex, 8 |B3 = Kindlebane Dagger |C3 = Inferno Vertex, 8 |Output = Pyrochaos Dagger }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Pyrochaos Dagger |rarity = l |damage = 160 |crit_chance = 10 |crit_damage = 25 |attack_speed = 20 |strength = 75 |special_effect = Deal {{Red|2x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs.
Deal {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Wither}} mobs.
Gain {{stat|Combat Wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. |item_ability_name = Attunement |item_ability_description = Swap between {{Grey|Ashen}} and {{Yellow|Auric}} mode in order to attack through Hellion Shields. |item_ability_activation = On Right Click |item_ability_name2 = Burning Vengeance ﬗ |item_ability_description2 = On hit, {{Red|repeat}} the last 6 hits of dealt damage after {{Green|6s}} if the Hellion Shield has switched attunement. }} The '''Pyrochaos Dagger''' deals {{Red|2x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs and {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs. Additionally, it provides {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. The '''Pyrochaos Dagger''' has {{Green|2}} abilities: * {{AN|Attunement}} allows the wielder to swap between {{DarkGray|'''Ashen'''}} and {{Yellow|'''Auric'''}} attunements in order to attack through the {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}}'s {{AN|Hellion Shield}} ability. When switching attunement, the '''Pyrochaos Dagger''' changes appearance from a {{Item|Iron Sword|link=}} to a {{Item|Golden Sword|link=}}. * {{AN|Burning Vengeance}} allows the wielder to {{Red|repeat}} the last {{Green|6}} hits of dealt damage after {{Green|6s}} upon hit if the {{AN|Hellion Shield}} has switched attunement. This does not affect the damage immunity of demons, and has a cap of {{Stat|dmg|25,000,000}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Mar 21|link=none|[[File:Pyrochaos Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Pyrochaos Dagger'''.}} {{History|2024/Nov 25|link=none|'''Pyrochaos Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+45}} against Blazes.}} {{History|2024/Nov 26|link=none|{{AN|Burning Vengeance}} is now capped at {{Red|50M}} damage.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Pyrochaos Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Pyrochaos Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Pyrochaos Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Pyrochaos Dagger'''.}} {{History|0.20.9|'''Pyrochaos Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+45}} against Blazes.|{{AN|Burning Vengeance}} is now capped at {{Red|50M}} damage.}} {{History|0.23.3|'''Pyrochaos Dagger''' perks changed to affect {{mt|Infernal}} and {{mt|Wither}} mobs.}} {{History|2026/Jan 12|{{AN|Burning Vengeance}} is now capped at {{Stat|Damage|25M}}|Fixed some situations when {{AN|Burning Vengeance}} {{Stat|Damage}} was dealt multiple times.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Pyrochaos Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Pyrochaos Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Blaze}} [[Category:Daggers]]
